origin.description: Formed by the coordinator for the revision-2.2 decision regression on Sepolia

objective.goal: Exercise the phase binding of collective decisions on the live chain: two ADVANCE proposals approved in stage 0 must not chain the swarm into stage 2, and an ADMIT approved in stage 0 must be refused after the advance and re-decided in stage 1.
successCriteria: The second stage-0 ADVANCE approval is refused in stage 1 (SAIDecision: phase changed)
The stage-0 ADMIT approval is refused in stage 1 and a stage-1 decision admits the candidate
A stage-1 ADVANCE decision reaches stage 2

acceptance.description: The deployer, as judge, records the outcome; the coordinator concludes

phases.name: stage-0
phases.description: Recruitment and first work stage. The verifier council (2-of-3 through the collective decision adapter) holds ADMIT and ADVANCE; the worker candidate applies here.

phases.name: stage-1
phases.description: Second stage; every member carries over. Decisions approved in stage 0 and not performed before the advance are void: the adapter binds each proposal to its filing phase (revision 2.2).

phases.name: stage-2
phases.description: Third stage; reached only by a decision taken in stage 1.

roles.name: sai.role.verifier
roles.description: Council of three; self-join; decides ADMIT and ADVANCE 2-of-3

roles.name: sai.role.worker
roles.description: Applies in stage 0; admitted by a council decision

ADMIT.description: Collective: verifier council 2-of-3 through the revision-2.2 collective decision adapter; each decision snapshots the council roster and binds the filing phase

ADVANCE.description: Collective: the same council and adapter

CONCLUDE.description: ADDRESS: the coordinator, or the judge as acceptance authority
